0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 9th in the West, 2 games back in the Southwest) host the Sacramento Kings (0-3, 15th in the West, 3 games back in the Pacific, on a three-game losing streak). Spurs ruled out are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while the Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
